pushA:shoulder-press.coach: Stay at 15 kg: 7 reps is in range, now aim for 8 on every set.

pushA:incline-db-press.coach: Stay at 10 kg: 7 reps is under 8, so get 8 on every set first.

pushA:cable-lateral.coach: Lighter: 4 to 7 reps at 10 kg is far under 12. Use 5 kg on another cable station, left arm first.

pushA:chest-fly.coach: Up one step: both sets reached 15 at 25 kg.

pushA:triceps-pushdown.coach: Up one step: every set reached 15 at 20 kg.

pushA:db-lateral.coach: Lighter: 9 reps at 5 kg is far under 15, so try 3 kg.

pullA:pull-up.coach: Work at 30 kg: you got 12 there. Go to 35 kg once every set reaches 10.

pullA:cable-row.coach: Stay at 20 kg: 10 is in range, now aim for 12 on every set.

pullA:straight-arm-pulldown.coach: Stay at 20 kg: 12 is the bottom of the range, aim for 13 or more.

pullA:reverse-fly.coach: Lighter: 6 reps at 10 kg is far under 12. If the shoulder hurts again, stop and switch to the face pull.

pullA:cable-lateral.coach: Lighter: 5 reps at 10 kg is far under 12. Use 5 kg on a station where it works, left arm first.

pullA:curl.coach: Stay at 5 kg with longer rests: 7, 6 and 4 fell under 8.

legsA:leg-press.coach: Empty sled again: 10 is in range, aim for 12 on every set, then add the first pair of plates.

legsA:rdl.coach: Stay at 20 kg: the first set gave only 6, so get 10 on every set first.

legsA:leg-curl.coach: Stay at 20 kg: 10 is in range, aim for 11 or more.

legsA:leg-extension.coach: Same 10 kg, slow, aim for 12. Use the lightest pin or drop it if the knee hurts.

legsA:standing-calf.coach: Stay at 20 kg: 10 is in range, aim for 12.

legsA:hanging-knee-raise.coach: Bodyweight again: 10 is in range, aim for 12.

pushB:incline-press.coach: First time: pick a weight you can press 8 times with 2 reps left.

pushB:shoulder-press.coach: Stay at 15 kg: 7 reps is under this day's 8, so aim for 8.

pushB:db-lateral.coach: Lighter: 9 reps at 5 kg is under 12, so try 4 kg.

pushB:dips.coach: First time: bodyweight dips, leaning forward. Use the chest press machine if 8 reps is not there.

pushB:overhead-triceps.coach: First time: start a little under your 20 kg pushdown and aim for 10.

pushB:cable-lateral.coach: Light day: 5 kg, left arm first, aim for 15.

pullB:lat-pulldown.coach: First time: start near 25 kg, since Pull A gave 10 there, and aim for 8 to 12.

pullB:chest-supported-row.coach: First time: pick a weight you can row 8 times with 2 reps left.

pullB:one-arm-row.coach: First time: pick a dumbbell you can row 10 times per side, left arm first.

pullB:face-pull.coach: First time: go light on the rope, aim for 15, and stop if the shoulder hurts.

pullB:cable-lateral.coach: 5 kg, left arm first: last time the left side was a rep behind.

pullB:hammer-curl.coach: First time: pick dumbbells you can curl 10 times with 2 reps left.

legsB:split-squat.coach: First time: start with light dumbbells or none, 8 reps per leg.

legsB:hip-thrust.coach: First time: pick a weight you can do 8 times with a pause at the top.

legsB:leg-curl.coach: Stay at 20 kg: 10 is in range, aim for 11 or more.

legsB:seated-calf.coach: First time: pick a weight you can do 12 times with a full stretch.

legsB:hanging-leg-raise.coach: First time: bodyweight, straight legs, slow on the way down.

cable-lateral.note: The 5 kg setting on that cable machine does not work.

reverse-fly.note: Shoulder pain on the first set.

rdl.note: Done on the cable machine, not the barbell.
